description: A small clear jar sits near the center-left, and to the right there’s a blue plate holding a blue die, with a yellow oval object and a small blue triangular piece nearby. The left hand reaches in from the left toward the die on the plate, pinches and lifts the die as a left-hand object, then carries it leftward and lowers it into the clear jar before releasing it; the right hand stays nearby on the right without touching anything.
